Pair this computer with a `serve` server using a one-time code: it gets its certificate, no file to hand over

```text
dspk pair [OPTIONS] <SERVER> <CODE>
```

**Arguments**

- **`<SERVER>`**  
  The server: host:port (the UDP port `dspk serve` listens on)
- **`<CODE>`**  
  The code the server showed, e.g. 42-8317-2956

**Options**

- **`--name <NAME>`**  
  What the server calls this computer (letters, digits, '.', '_', '-'; default: its host name)
- **`--out <OUT>`**  
  Where to write this computer's identity (default: &lt;name>.dspk-identity.pem here; mode 0600). Give it to `dspk receive --identity`, `dspk remote --identity`, or the app
